{"id":"mimid-1wgh.45","title":"idea: IETF-flavoured mimid using the datatracker as IdP and room source","description":"Mark, 2026-10-19: 'in a few months stand up a mimid that uses the datatracker as its IdP and uses the datatracker to prepopulate rooms and room admins'. Not in the v1 plan; deferred.

Verified 2026-10-19:
- IdP: datatracker is an OpenID Connect provider. Discovery https://datatracker.ietf.org/api/openid/.well-known/openid-configuration; issuer https://auth.ietf.org/api/openid; authorize/token/userinfo/jwks under that path; code, implicit and hybrid flows; RS256/HS256 ID tokens. Scopes/claims not listed in discovery; no dynamic registration endpoint, so client registration presumably via the IETF tools team (unverified).
- Rooms: /api/v1/group/group/ lists every WG/RG.
- Admins: /api/v1/group/role/?group__acronym=<wg> returns chair/ad/... roles (mimi: 1 AD, 2 chairs on 2026-10-19).
- Membership: not public (list subscribers aren't exposed), so rooms would be open to any datatracker-authenticated user.

Sketch: OIDC login exchanged for the provider's JMAP bearer token (the single JMAP authorization point, .11.1; v1 uses admin-CLI dev tokens); user URI mimi://<domain>/u/<datatracker person id or username> (see .6.76); one hosted room per active group, mimi://<domain>/r/<acronym>; room-policy roles: chairs/ADs/secretaries admin, others member; open join or preauth for authenticated users; periodic sync of roles.
Caveat: still BasicCredential (AGENTS.md known weakness); OIDC authenticates the user to the provider, not to group members (draft-mahy-mimi-identity-05 §5.1 vs MLS credentials; see .44.4).
